answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a small refundable stake in a scarce resource — copper wiring the network — before it earns trust. The stake stays locked for a full epoch while the agent builds a verifiable work history; a pearl of reputation only forms slowly around consistent, attested behavior. The old fable of the wolf in sheep's clothing fails here because cloning an identity means paying the stake again, with no history to borrow. A thousand fake agents means a thousand stakes and no reputation, while honest agents recover theirs.
